items.name: USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker: Nov. 9, 2026
items.summary: These are the approximate positions of the U.S. Navy’s deployed carrier strike groups and amphibious ready groups throughout the world as of Nov. 9, 2026, based on Navy and public data. In cases in which a CSG or ARG is conducting disaggregated operations, the chart reflects the location of the capital ship.  In Japan USS Tripoli (LHA-7) is in port in Sasebo, Japan. In the Sea of Japan Amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD-8) departed Saturday from Yokosuka, Japan, according to ship spotters.
